name: io.github.sepehr071/bale-mcp
title: Bale Bot
description: Private, local Bale bot for agents: read, search and answer messages, ask and wait, files.

environmentVariables.name: BALE_ALLOWED_CHATS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated chat ids or @usernames the bot may read and message; all other chats are ignored. Recommended.

environmentVariables.name: BALE_MCP_DB
environmentVariables.description: Local message history file (default ~/.bale-mcp/messages.db); ':memory:' keeps nothing on disk.

environmentVariables.name: BALE_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for every request; system proxy settings are ignored.
